name: Storm Snake

defensiveAbilities.name: Static Shock
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the storm snake or damages it with an unarmed melee attack or non-reach melee weapon

Effect The triggering enemy is shocked for 2d8 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a failed save, the target is Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lightning Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The storm snake redirects the lightning it has absorbed from storms, dealing 2d10 Electricity Damage damage to a single target within 20 feet (Basic DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a failure, the target is Dazzled until the end of its next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Static Field
offensiveAbilities.description:
The storm snake gathers all static electricity in the area before releasing it in a 30ft Emanation that deals 3d12 Electricity Damage damage to all non-plant creatures (DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save) and grants plant creatures 5 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Plant life in the area begins to grow significantly faster than the average for plants of their genus; in forests, fields, or otherwise floral locations, this immediately transforms the area into non-magical difficult terrain. The storm snake can't use Static field again for 1d4 rounds.

Effect: Static Field

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Arcana, DC 20
